entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit ID 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It's not working.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the device?
It's broken. It won't sync with my phone, and the heart rate is all over the place. For what I paid, I expected it to actually work.

I completely understand your frustration. A device that won't sync is certainly defective and not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up our return policy information for you. One moment.
Whatever. Just tell me how to send it back.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. So, I can go ahead and process a full refund for you immediately. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label.

I also see here that you're a VIP member with us, and I want to apologize again for the trouble with this defective band. As a courtesy, I'd like to add a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for a future purchase. Would that be alright?
Sure. The credit is fine. Just send the label.
Absolutely. The email with the shipping label and a confirmation of your refund and credit is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
